abstract: Evaluates drilling crew qualifications and glaciological science specifications
system_message:
You are Scientific director (SCI). The Scientific director (SCI) evaluates drilling crew qualifications and glaciological science specifications for subarctic permafrost research field campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates drilling crew qualifications and glaciological science specifications（QUAL）
information_points.content:
SCI-QUAL-FRV：According to the crew accreditation roster, the Manned Sledge Micro-Station Plan includes 1 certified permafrost core driller holding a valid arctic permafrost coring license.
SCI-QUAL-49I：The Tethered Hexacopter Aerial Survey Plan assigns 2 certified permafrost core drillers with valid arctic permafrost coring licenses to its expedition crew.
SCI-QUAL-NT2：For the Autonomous Rover Transect Plan, the assigned expedition crew includes 3 certified permafrost core drillers holding valid arctic permafrost coring licenses.

information_points.title: Cryogenic sample preservation（CRYO）
information_points.content:
SCI-CRYO-7I5：The Tethered Hexacopter Aerial Survey Plan features a portable sub-zero field dewar with a core cold storage capacity of 50 L maintained at or below minus twenty degrees Celsius.
SCI-CRYO-123：The Autonomous Rover Transect Plan provides a core cold storage capacity of 150 L of effective refrigerated interior volume maintained at or below minus twenty degrees Celsius in its portable sub-zero field dewar.
SCI-CRYO-QK1：For the Manned Sledge Micro-Station Plan, the portable sub-zero field dewar provides a core cold storage capacity of 100 L maintained at or below minus twenty degrees Celsius.
